decision: Announced identity-only successor for the tokio 1.53.3 security patch (RUSTSEC-2026-0386) in the root Cargo.lock, after the 0.4.1 release successor. The CSV Lambda lockgraph receives the same patch. Only tokio's version and checksum change; lineage_sources.v1.json changes only its generated_at_sha. All behavior fixtures, lineage source hashes, historical-v1 objects and earlier transition ledgers remain byte-identical.
plan_reference: Owner release request 2026-10-23 (signed jope v0.4.1); cargo deny advisories fails on main since RUSTSEC-2026-0386; ADR-0004
